capabilities: insert saved text by holding two letter keys together within an 80 ms window
edit a JSON chord dictionary in a modal and save it to plugin data
pause and resume chord interception from the command palette or settings
bind dictionaries to vault folders so notes use per-folder phrases (Pro)
import and export dictionary JSON files (Pro)
extras: Freemium: two-letter chords and the dictionary editor are free; folder dictionaries, dictionary files and three-letter chords require a GitHub Sponsors payment and sign-in. The free tier needs no account and makes no network requests until sign-in. Requires a physical keyboard that reports overlapping key holds; screen keyboards do not work. The What's new tab promotes other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat and can be turned off. Several devices and scenarios (iPad/Android keyboards, IME, pop-out windows) are listed as untested.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert frequently used text from simultaneous key presses rather than typed shortcuts or templates.

relations.evidence: Sign in uses the GitHub device flow.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 once)

summary: Text expander that inserts saved phrases when two letter keys are held together on a physical keyboard while editing a Markdown note.
